scripts.dev: npm run build -w @ecotrack/shared && concurrently "npm run dev -w @ecotrack/api" "npm run dev -w @ecotrack/web"
scripts.dev:web: npm run build -w @ecotrack/shared && npm run dev -w @ecotrack/web
scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w @ecotrack/shared && npm run dev -w @ecotrack/api
scripts.build: npm run build -w @ecotrack/shared && npm run build -w @ecotrack/api && npm run build -w @ecotrack/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @ecotrack/shared && npm run typecheck -w @ecotrack/api && npm run typecheck -w @ecotrack/web
